verdict.rationale: The evidence includes an 'Ironclad AI' product page, but the captured snippets are only taglines ('Built on how contracts really move', 'A New Era of Contract Intelligence'). None of them describe a built-in assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The workflow-API material on running AI-driven analysis is a developer building block for constructing such features, not a built-in assistant, so it earns no credit.
